authority_chain.selector: semantic local +X planar face after yaw+pitch transform
authority_chain.axis: normalize(2*localX + 4*localY + 3*localZ), containing both face-normal and tangent components
authority_chain.topology_rebuild: target planar face + four OCCT ruled adjacent surfaces through BRepTools_ReShape

bounded_scope: R001 starts from an 80x50x10 mm box, yaw +30 deg, pitch +20 deg, and rotates the semantic local +X face +2 deg about an offset arbitrary 3D axis
R002 starts from a 100x60x12 mm box, yaw -25 deg, pitch -15 deg, and rotates the semantic local +X face -2.5 deg about the same semantic axis/pivot family
the governed axis has absolute selected-face-normal component 0.3713906763541037 in both revisions and therefore is neither tangent to nor near-normal to the selected face
the pivot offset length is 8.30662386291807 mm in R001 and 8.306623862918075 mm in R002 and is not the selected-face center
the target face center moves 0.25934744933732146 mm in R001 and 0.3241750535452786 mm in R002 as a consequence of offset-pivot rotation
the target face plus four adjacent faces are rebuilt while the opposite face center/area remain unchanged; both results remain valid one-solid six-face B-Reps
zero angle, angle above the bounded contract, tangent-axis, near-normal-axis, center-pivot, over-distance pivot and zero axis coefficients all fail closed
FCStd plus separate R001/R002 STEP masters persist axis direction, axis origin, coefficients, pivot offsets and FreeCAD/OCCT geometry authority
Blender creates two tessellated display derivatives and preserves axis/pivot metadata, FCStd hash and DISPLAY_DERIVATIVE_ONLY authority across save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Invalidate if the operation no longer uses an authoritative FreeCAD/OCCT B-Rep master, the governed axis loses either normal or tangent component, the pivot is no longer offset, opposite-face preservation or one-solid/six-face checks are removed, failure cases stop failing closed, axis/pivot metadata cease to persist in FCStd lineage, or Blender save/reopen stops preserving source hash and display-only authority.
authority_note: This receipt proves one bounded offset-pivot non-tangent arbitrary-axis planar-face rotation family. It narrows the prior tangent-axis blocker but does not prove unrestricted arbitrary-axis editing, arbitrary pivot placement, nonplanar-face direct editing, persistent topology naming, or P0-B professional parity.
